Reuse AttentionMemory; preserve Focus; do not create a task database, recommendation engine, new authority system, provider/DAW action, or taste/Skill evidence.

completion_proof: all five canonical Not Now horizons are represented as durable Attention state
Later this Song expires for display when the exact Song work-thread anchor changes
Next Song suppresses only the Song on which it was chosen
After release remains scoped to the bound Song and becomes eligible when verified release state is supplied
Someday and Never suggest again remain suppressed until explicit restore
every deferral is reversible and supersession preserves history
Not Now choices do not create EvidenceClaims, Skill state, taste doctrine, authority, DAW/provider actions or a new task/recommendation object
deferrals are isolated by Artist profile and foreign Song binding fails closed
consumer POSTs retain exact-host, Origin, CSRF and one-shot replay protection
stale Song/thread bindings fail closed before deferral mutation
quit/relaunch preserves active deferral and restore returns the original canonical NOW thread
full governance, regression and staged consumer smoke pass on Linux, Windows and macOS at the exact active-receipt head
